warning: Scores are transparent heuristic priorities, not calibrated probabilities, ROI forecasts, live market truth, or execution authorization. Dynamic project facts require live refresh before material action.

candidates.why: Highest immediate information value for measuring latency, tool cost, context load, recovery, human override and accepted-decision quality with minimal external risk.
High information gain. Any open contradiction/unknown permits verification/research only; it does not authorize supplier commitment or requirement rewrite.
Quantity, price, payment, permit and supplier availability are dynamic and must be refreshed before material commercial action.
Production rate and final SKU geometry remain decision-sensitive unknowns; resolving them increases downstream sourcing quality.
Historical throughput conflict requires revalidation before the value can be used as a stable requirement. Lower portfolio priority does not convert the working value into fact.

hard_rule: Any external send, purchase, merge, deploy, permission change, production DB mutation, contract, payment or exact consequential action remains separately human-gated.
